slides.question: One word: what does 1995 sound like?
slides.notes: Warm-up, not scored. Let it run until the cloud stops moving.

slides.question: Which band released OK Computer in 1997?
slides.notes: Radiohead, June 1997. Index 1 — the second option.

slides.question: Which TWO of these albums came out in 1991?
slides.notes: Nevermind (Sept 1991) and Ten (Aug 1991). Definitely Maybe is 1994, Jagged Little Pill 1995. Both must be selected — no partial credit.

slides.question: Who sang "Wannabe"?
slides.notes: Spice Girls, 1996. Both spellings accepted; matching is case-insensitive.
